_note: The intel room: the floor of the first placed object of base_asset (the military hangar), with the screen on the wall of its far end, facing the entrance. Its screen shows every announced event (when, what, risks, where); with several it shows one at a time, rotate_seconds each, and only within view_range_m of the camera. room is in the object's own frame (before its rotation and scale): floor_m = floor top above its origin, at = [x, z] of the screen's middle on the wall, facing = [x, z] unit vector into the room, bottom_m = lower edge above the floor; width_m x height_m is the screen's size. Nothing reads the model, so it is the same for a player without the pack. open_parts = node names of the prefab that are hidden and stop colliding so players can walk in (the small door of the entrance end; the big doors are solid). The prefab SM_Bld_Hangar_01 (30.6 x 36.3 m, doors on both ends, end walls inside at z = -16.28 and z = +16.14) has the screen on the -z end on the door panel x = 0 to 4.56 (its inner face is z = -16.006) and the entrance at the small door of the +z end. A map without the object falls back to the command post of base_bunker (an id of the map's bunkers.json; w378900206 stands nearest the church); with neither there is no intel room, and the announcement still reaches everyone.
